title: Patch: Radiant Rollback Point brings its Units back on their printed face, with Rush, not Radiant

**Issue #5158 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #5158: Patch: Radiant Rollback Point brings its Units back on their printed face, with Rush, not Radiant
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

In the Infinite Assault, the level-10 Commander Loopback, Who Returns plays Rollback Point. The card summons copies of the three most expensive Units its side has lost this game, and its Radiant version adds only 'They have Rush'.

When a day's Fine-Tuned upgrade makes that card Radiant, the three copies come back Radiant too. That gives them twice their stats and their stronger text, which the card never says. So a player who has just cleared the Commander's board faces three doubled Units that can all attack at once. Once fixed, they come back as their normal versions, with Rush.

## Why

- **What the card should do.** SPEC §8.13 row 224 and R4594005 say: 'Each is a fresh copy on its printed face, most expensive first, with Rush on the Radiant face.' The script's own header says the same (`crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c224_rollback_point.rs:10`).
- **What it does.** The script passes its own face (`radiant`) into every summon's arguments (`c224_rollback_point.rs:57`), so the Radiant face summons Radiant copies.
- **How players meet it:**
  - IA #224 is one of the two cards of the rank II Commander Loopback, Who Returns (`crates/run/src/assault.json:56`), the boss of level 10.
  - The Fine-Tuned upgrade (§16.3) makes 3 more of an enemy deck's cards start Radiant per stack.
  - A Commander level takes two upgrades after its card step (`ASSAULT_COMMANDER_UPGRADES`).
- **No test catches it.** The Radiant test `r4594005_the_copies_have_rush` checks only Rush and which Units come back, never their face. The base tests never play the Radiant face.

## Proposal

1. Summon each copy on its printed face: drop the `radiant` flag from the summon's arguments, and keep the Rush on the Radiant face.
2. Add to both faces' tests that each copy is not Radiant and has its printed stats.
3. Keep the shipped behaviour for replays, if this card's recorded games fold under the catalog version they were played on (R767000, `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`; Assault fights are kept for replay since R5125000). Keep today's script as a `script_v…`, registered in `crates/cards/src/history.rs` for the versions it shipped in, as other cards do.
4. Write the pending patch fragment with `cargo jackioh patches`, and its player note by hand.
5. The spec row already says what the fix does. It gains only a line naming the issue.

## Where it lands

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c224_rollback_point.rs` (the script and its tests)
- `crates/cards/src/history.rs` (the shipped script, kept for replays)
- a pending patch fragment, and one line on SPEC §8.13 row 224

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] In a test named after R4594005, a Radiant Rollback Point's copies are on their printed face (not Radiant, printed stats) and have Rush.
- [ ] A base Rollback Point's copies are on their printed face with no Rush, as today.
- [ ] A recorded game that cast a Radiant Rollback Point under the old script folds to its recorded hash, or is handled as R767000 says for its version.
- [ ] These are green: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c224_rollback_point`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`.

## Size and risks

- **Size:** small, about 3 to 4 files, difficulty medium (a card change).
- **Balance:** the level-10 Commander gets weaker only in fights where its Rollback Point is Radiant. `cargo jackioh assault-sim`'s wide bands hold the Assault's tuning (SPEC §16, Tuning), and this is unlikely to move them.

---

All three new tests are in `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c224_rollback_point.rs`.

- **Helper**, inside `mod tests` next to `field_ids`:
  ```rust
  /// Lanes 1 and 2 as `(radiant, attack, max health, has Rush)`.
  fn copies(s: &Scenario) -> Vec<(bool, i32, i32, bool)> {
      [1, 2].into_iter().map(|lane| {
          let unit = s.unit_at(P1, lane);
          let view = unit_view(s.state(), &unit);
          let rush = view.keywords.iter().any(|keyword| keyword.kind() == KeywordKind::Rush);
          (unit.radiant, view.attack, view.max_health, rush)
      }).collect()
  }
  ```
- **`mod base`, `r4594005_the_copies_are_on_their_printed_face_without_rush`:** `copies(&wipe_and_point(false, "rollback-base"))` equals `vec![(false, 6, 6, false), (false, 5, 5, false)]`. DEAR is 6/6 and MID is 5/5.
- **`mod radiant`, `r4594005_the_copies_are_on_their_printed_face_with_rush`:** `copies(&wipe_and_point(true, "rollback-radiant"))` equals `vec![(false, 6, 6, true), (false, 5, 5, true)]`. Before the fix this gives `(true, 12, 12, true)` and `(true, 10, 10, true)`, because a stand-in's Radiant fallback doubles its stats (`RADIANT_FALLBACK_FACTOR` is 2), so the test fails without the fix.
- **New `mod before_printed_face`:** it starts with `use super::*;` and `use super::super::script_before_printed_face;`.
  - **`r767000_r4594005_a_game_before_issue_5158_summons_radiant_copies_on_the_radiant_face`:** run `crate::under_kept(ID, script_before_printed_face(), || copies(&wipe_and_point(true, "rollback-radiant")))` (pattern: `c012_fortify.rs`, `mod before_help_aim`). Assert it equals `vec![(true, 12, 12, true), (true, 10, 10, true)]`.
  - The `r767000` token is allowed without editing `spec/rulings/R0767000.md`, because `spec check` requires only that the ruling's note exists.

```

- [ ] A Radiant Rollback Point's copies are not Radiant, have printed stats and Rush: the R4594005 radiant test is green.
- [ ] A base Rollback Point's copies are on their printed face with no Rush: the R4594005 base test is green.

- [ ] Decisions recorded in the report: the kept row is inert today (see Risks), and `copies_radiant` is a parameter, not a copy of the closure.

## Risks

- **Replay and the kept script.**
  - Infinite Assault cards are in no snapshot (R1420), so every carried catalog drops them (`build.rs`'s `absent`; `history.rs::build`). The kept row therefore changes no fold today: no carried catalog holds Rollback Point.
  - The issue asks for the row anyway. It is also the only claim that makes the fragment valid, since a fragment with no claim fails `patches check` unless a kept row is keyed by it (R4844000). It also holds the boundary if the set ever enters a snapshot.
  - Do not "fix" this by claiming `plays`: classify ignores a script of a set that has not shipped, so `rust (classify)` would refute it.
- **Contingency.** If `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `patches check` or `classify --claims` fails because of the kept row or the fragment, do not weaken a check. Stop and report which check failed and why. Dropping both the row and the fragment is a fallback to offer, not to take: a card of this set otherwise takes no fragment, and this fix would then have no player note.
- **Base-face determinism.** The base face used to pass `"radiant": false` and now omits the key. The engine reads `== Some(true)` everywhere (`summon.rs` lines 496, 544, 566, 651, 668, 712 and 883), so the summoned card is identical.
- **Fragment stem.** `fragment_name` truncates at 60 characters, and the stem I computed is 53. If the builder changes the title, recompute the stem from the created file's name.
- **Balance.** Only a Radiant Rollback Point (level-10 Commander Loopback after Fine-Tuned) gets weaker. `cargo jackioh assault-sim` is not needed for the checks, so skip it unless time allows.

## Open questions

None that block the work. One for a person, optional: since no carried catalog holds Infinite Assault cards, replays of a kept Assault fight from an older version are refused regardless of this card. Whether snapshots should start carrying single-player sets is a separate decision, outside #5158.
````
